name: Mongolian five-toed jerboa
desc: A hopping desert rodent that eats seeds and plants and is hunted by foxes, falcons and eagles.
about: The Mongolian five-toed jerboa or Siberian jerboa is a species of rodent in the family Dipodidae. It is found in China, Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Mongolia, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan.
